name: Kamimura Maika
source:
Faction: Taimanin
Skill: Fire Tecnique: "Grenade" (Katon no Jutsu "Gu re nei do" <Gureneido>), Intense Explosion
Artist: [url=/s5690]sian[/url]
Card: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/0f439036122cadfca57ce3e15fbd53a5.png]TM 4 Stars[/url]
History:
A Taimanin of the Kamimura clan of Gosha Village.
Even among the Fire Art Taimanin, her sheer power is outstanding. However, just like Yukikaze she requires a handmade weapon, the "Meido Bazooka", to control her abilities with a Limiter. Maika has engraved the word Grenade on the barrel, which is also the name of her Fire Art.
She is known as a hard-boiled, bully, Yankee girl in Gosha Academy but actually adores cute things and tries to hide it, with more and more people looking past the facade. Her sister [url=/c66512]Kamimura Azuma[/url] left the Taimanin as she could not awake to her own Ninja Art and has his sense, used Onmyoji powers to kill demons and vampires her own way, regardless the sisters seem not to dislike each other.
Maika is often part of the Fire Squad Unit, either as a member or a leader of one of the units.
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Kamimura_Maika]breezewiki.com[/url]]
